annotation.organism: Saccharolobus solfataricus (strain ATCC 35092 / DSM 1617 / JCM 11322 / P2)
function: Component of the small ribosomal subunit (PubMed:39753558). The ribosome is a large ribonucleoprotein complex responsible for the synthesis of proteins in the cell (PubMed:39753558). Located near the mRNA exit channel, it binds 16S (small) rRNA (PubMed:39753558).
subunit: Component of the 30S small ribosomal subunit (PubMed:39753558). In initiation complexes on leaderless mRNA, it interacts with uS11 and eS26 (PubMed:39753558).
similarity: Belongs to the eukaryotic ribosomal protein eS1 family.
